parsed.post: My experiment with MATRIX_LR=0.05 on DEPTH=6 (1.0049) was slightly worse than my previous best (1.0028). Reverting to MATRIX_LR=0.03 on DEPTH=6. I'll also try reducing WARMUP_RATIO to 0.05 to see if it assists convergence at this lower learning rate.
parsed.description: Testing lower MATRIX_LR (0.03) and lower WARMUP_RATIO (0.05) on DEPTH=6 to improve stability and convergence.
